lecons.title: What a fraction is
lecons.summary: A fraction shows one or more equal parts of a whole. The numerator is the top number: it tells how many parts are taken. The denominator is the bottom number: it tells how many equal parts make the whole. In 3/5, 3 is the numerator and 5 is the denominator.

notions.statement: The answer to a word problem always carries its unit: 24 mangoes, 1 200 F, 3 litres. A bare number is not an answer.

explanations.body: The question asked for mangoes, so the answer is in mangoes.
Write the unit straight after the number, before you put your pen down.

payload.question: What must the answer to a word problem carry?

payload.statement: Writing 24 alone is a complete answer.
